name: GEOG 6815
title: Seminar on Geographic Information Science and Systems
description: An exploration of Geographic Information Science (GISc) and Systems (GIS) theories, methods, and critiques for physical and social sciences. Topics may range from fundamental to emergent themes including measurement biases, uncertainties, qualitative GIS, spatial big data, human dynamics, and GeoAI. May be repeated for a total of six credits. May be repeated for a total of 6 credits.
